title: Northwind / Harbor Retail on-prem license with sales royalty
why_hard: The license runs on the customer's servers and is paid partly by a sales royalty, so timing and the royalty exception both turn on reading past the word "license".
source: Fixture written for tests; not a real contract.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions
clauses.text: "Software" means Licensor's PriceLens retail pricing engine in object code form, including the pricing module and the Documentation. "Net Sales" means gross amounts invoiced by Licensee to its retail customers for products whose shelf price was set using the pricing module, less returns, discounts and sales taxes. "Updates" means bug fixes, patches and minor releases that Licensor makes generally available.

clauses.heading: 2. Grant of License
clauses.text: Subject to this Agreement, Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to install and use the Software on servers owned or controlled by Licensee, solely for Licensee's internal retail operations in the United States. The Software is fully functional on delivery and Licensor has no obligation to change it except as provided in Section 5.

clauses.heading: 3. Delivery and Installation
clauses.text: Licensor will make the Software available for download within five (5) business days after the Effective Date. Licensee is responsible for installing, hosting and operating the Software on its own infrastructure. Licensor does not host, operate or provide access to the Software as a service.

clauses.heading: 4. License Fee
clauses.text: Licensee will pay Licensor a one-time license fee of US$400,000, invoiced on delivery of the Software and due thirty (30) days after the invoice date. The license fee is non-refundable except as provided in Section 10.

clauses.heading: 5. Support and Maintenance
clauses.text: For three (3) years from delivery, Licensor will provide telephone and email support during business hours, use commercially reasonable efforts to correct reproducible errors, and provide Licensee with Updates when and if they become available. Licensee will pay an annual support fee of US$60,000, invoiced in advance at the start of each support year.

clauses.heading: 6. Royalty
clauses.text: In addition to the fees in Sections 4 and 5, Licensee will pay Licensor a running royalty equal to one and one-half percent (1.5%) of Net Sales. Within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Licensee will deliver a report of Net Sales for that quarter together with payment of the royalty due.

clauses.heading: 7. Late Payment
clauses.text: Any amount not paid when due bears a late fee of one percent (1%) per month on the unpaid balance, or the maximum rate permitted by law if lower, until paid.

clauses.heading: 8. Marketing Attribution
clauses.text: Licensee may display the phrase "Pricing by PriceLens" and Licensor's logo on internal dashboards generated by the Software. Licensee grants Licensor a license to use Licensee's name in customer lists. Neither party receives any other right in the other's trademarks.

clauses.heading: 9. Audit
clauses.text: Once per calendar year, on thirty (30) days' notice, Licensor may have an independent accountant audit Licensee's records relating to Net Sales. If an audit reveals an underpayment of more than five percent (5%), Licensee will pay the underpayment and the reasonable cost of the audit.

clauses.heading: 10. Warranty
clauses.text: Licensor warrants that for ninety (90) days after delivery the Software will perform substantially in accordance with the Documentation. Licensee's exclusive remedy for breach of this warranty is repair or replacement of the Software or, if Licensor cannot do so, a refund of the license fee and termination of the license.

clauses.heading: 11. Term and Termination
clauses.text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until terminated. Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of notice. Sections 6, 7 and 9 survive termination for amounts accrued before termination.
